Frozen configuration

Inherited settings affect their subtree; component settings target only their documented element.

Public entry points

--re-primary, --re-primary-end, --re-on-primary, --re-font, --re-font-heading, --re-radius, --re-gap, --re-bg, --re-surface, --re-text, --re-muted, --re-link, --re-line, --re-control-line.

Colour overrides require contrast checks for text, states and gradients. A new primary colour does not automatically create an accessible theme.
